title: Lomotor's new single "Strawberry Super Moon" glows with summer ecstasy
htmlContent: With the music world awash in formulaic beats and recycled hooks, Lomotor steps out of the forest with "Strawberry Super Moon," a shimmery, hypnotic single that's the aural equivalent of an invite to some as yet undiscovered midsummer ritual. On this new track, Lomotor creates a soundtrack that is as elemental as it is divine and beckons the listener to a lush renewal and nature's abundance. What started as an easygoing modular synth experiment eventually put down roots in a much more transcendent place. The heart of "Strawberry Super Moon" is the dirty, quirky little voice of a Mutable Instruments Plaits module, acted upon by shady, gangster-like guitar pedals while under surveillance by juicy twists of reanimated tape on rich, glistening delays. The result is a swirling sonic stream that feels alive and organic as if the machines are themselves barefoot and swaying in the moonlight. There's a feeling of movement on the track that can't be denied. From the opening resonant pulse, you can nearly make out the silhouettes of the dancers assembled on a forested hilltop, the soft earth beneath their feet, the scent of summer blossoms mixing ever so delicately with the cool night air. Lomotor conjures a ritual where the lines between humans and nature blur into blissful union. "Strawberry Super Moon" is unlike much electronic music in that it's warm and, at times, human. Every warped vocal, each delay tail, seems surreptitiously placed there to ramp up the feeling of collective joy. https://open.spotify.com/track/64GZ7U2goMK8ve6RwTvB1a?si=860bf1d582f94c9c It's not hard to picture the track as the score to late-night hangouts where strangers become friends, and the cares of the world melt away in the light of that outsized strawberry moon. Lomotor's sound design is experimental and approachable at the same time. The modular synth textures are still exploratory, but they are never distancing. They don't so much challenge as they draw the listener further into the groove, willing them to give in to the moment's magic. "Strawberry Super Moon" is an experience offered by Lomotor. It's a musical reminder that, even in an increasingly digital age, we all still yearn to connect with nature, one another, and the eternal rhythms that have led us forward since the first sustained drumbeat under the open sky.
excerpt: Lomotor's new single, "Strawberry Super Moon," radiates summer ecstasy, blending energetic melodies with a luminous vibe perfect for the season.
